label: rejected
reviewer: blind fresh agent (renders + close-ups + gate report + rubric only)

evidence.V1: Front outline (blade, crescent guard, wrapped grip, ball pommel) and 3/4 silhouette both read instantly as a dagger; top view is the weakest (a small gold bar with blade diamond and end balls) but still reads as a crossguard; A15 symmetry error X=0, Y=0 and the front outline is mirror-even.
evidence.V2: Clear tiers: blade is the big shape, crescent guard and ball pommel are medium, gem, guard-tip balls and three gold grip bands are small details.
evidence.V3: Confident stylised proportions: oversized ball pommel, upturned crescent guard, short broad blade with dark fuller; guard and gem centred on grip axis (alignment offset 0.0), blade seated 0.128 into guard, nothing floating.
evidence.V4: Inconsistent: guard and pommel collar carry soft bevels that catch light, but the blade has hard faceted edges and a needle tip, and grip bands read nearly unbevelled next to the rounded guard.
evidence.V5: Mostly clean smooth shading, but the pommel close-up shows a visibly polygonal sphere outline (stray faceting) and the guard flat close-up shows a lumpy outline where the left tip ball merges into the guard end.
evidence.V6: Disciplined: steel greys on blade, gold accent on guard/bands/pommel, one hue (teal) in grip/gem; crimson and shadow colourways swap only that hue cleanly.
evidence.V7: 2268 tris vs weapon target 2500 (ceiling 4000), budget_note ok.
evidence.V8: One white vertex-colour material and kit palette match, but the low-segment pommel sphere and hard blade facets clash with the smooth, chamfered kit look of the guard.
evidence.V9: Studio line correct: Tool Handle at grip point, CollisionFidelity Hull, CanCollide off when equipped, Massless, MeshPart.Color white, SmoothPlastic.

artifacts: Pommel sphere silhouette visibly faceted (low segment count) in Dagger_02_close_pommel_studio.png
Lumpy/blobby outline at the left guard tip where the tip-ball shell intersects the guard end (Dagger_02_close_guard_flat.png); 263 cross-shell overlaps in gate report
Dark smudge in the lower blade fuller in the front view reads as a shading blotch rather than a clean groove
top_fixes: Raise the pommel sphere segment count (or bevel-subdivide) so its outline is round at close range
Blend the guard-tip balls into the guard ends (smaller penetration or a fillet) so the tip outline is a clean curl instead of a lump
Add a ~0.045-stud chamfer to the blade edges, fuller rims and grip bands so edge treatment matches the guard and kit
Shallow or widen the fuller so it does not render as a dark blotch near the guard
